title: Revenue tile shows Parts and Labor as whole percentages, or the invoice count
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in a fresh test location made for this run, so nothing else is invoiced, credited or clocked there; on the Dashboard, the Revenue tile on This Week reads $0.00 with 0 Invoices.
  3. Timing: you run the whole case on one day, and not on the last evening of the week, so every record you create stays inside This Week.
  4. Data: a test customer with one contact and one asset that uses that contact (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer 1, contact Dana Test, unit ZZ-101). Its Default Shop Supplies is 0, so the invoice carries only labor and parts.
  5. Data: an in-stock inventory part with a Sell price (e.g. $100.00) that this location can sell.
  6. People (Advisor A): you (Admin ShopView); the Service Advisor in the work order's left panel shows your name by default.
  7. Data: one work order for that customer, ready but not invoiced yet: Service Advisor Advisor A, one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour (Estimated Time 2.00, Tech Time 2.00) with the part added (quantity 1, In stock); line completed and the work order marked reviewed.
